summary.intent: Clean up phase-46 worktrees, switch to the phase-47 branch, and resolve all open PR review comments on PR #494.
summary.outcome: Worktrees removed and branch switched successfully. Two CodeRabbit findings fixed and verified (202/202 tests, build clean, lint clean), but the resulting commit is blocked pending 1Password SSH agent recovery — changes are safely staged.

repo: PR #495 (edit-filepointer cross-client-sync fix) landed as part of the phase-46 fast-forward merge, not as a separate merge commit — the git pull output listing `edit-filepointer.mjs` was the #495 merge itself.
Phase-47 branch was 2 commits behind main after phase-46 merge landed; a rebase onto origin/main was recommended but not yet performed.
The project enforces signed commits (gpg.format=ssh with an ed25519 key via 1Password), which means --no-gpg-sign cannot be used for PRs.
dist/ in sdk-core is gitignored; only source files need staging after fixes.

The root cause of the phase-46 cross-client-sync 400 was that PR #488 changed updateFileMetadata to publish the file record internally, but the E2E helper edit-filepointer.mjs still passed the old ipnsRecord contract.

code.finding: Jitter formula `(0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5)` produces [0.5, 1.0) — only negative jitter — contradicting the line-20 doc comment claiming ±50%. Fix: `(0.5 + Math.random())` gives [0.5x, 1.5x) symmetric jitter.

resolveIpnsRecord call and the 'not found' throw were placed before the try block, so fileIpnsPrivateKey.fill(0) in the finally was skipped on failure — violating the T-47-01 caller-owned-zeroing requirement. Fix: move both inside the try.

workflow: Use `gh api graphql` with the reviewThreads query (isResolved filter) to enumerate unresolved PR threads; reply via REST with --field in_reply_to and resolve via GraphQL mutation.

Killing a signed commit mid-flight (e.g., via timeout) wedges the 1Password SSH agent — subsequent attempts fail with 'failed to fill whole buffer'. Recovery requires fully quitting and relaunching 1Password.
Running background unsandboxed commits (`dangerouslyDisableSandbox`) allows the Touch ID prompt to surface, but does not protect against an already-wedged agent.
Scoping test runs to the affected package (pnpm --filter) and following with a build step covers both runtime correctness and type correctness for public-API packages.

friction: 1Password SSH signing agent wedged after the first `timeout 45`-killed commit attempt, causing all subsequent commit attempts to fail with 'failed to fill whole buffer' — required manual user intervention (quit/relaunch 1Password) to recover.
Initial commit retry used `dangerouslyDisableSandbox` but still hung due to the already-wedged agent, requiring a second retry cycle and user action.
open_items: Commit for the two staged review fixes (cas.ts, file/index.ts) still pending 1Password recovery — background commit job b79vhcr79 running at end of transcript.

Rebase phase-47 branch onto origin/main to pick up the edit-filepointer fix and FUSE changes from phase 46 — suggested but deferred.
